intent: Implement Runtime 6.1.0 controlled lifecycle evolution and converge the exact DataRig Suite 2.1.11 production reference through immutable successor proposal, champion challenger validation, policy-bounded activation, monitoring, rollback, and generic-gap Target escalation.
objective: Deliver a project-neutral Runtime control plane that can learn from exact project Pipeline evidence and safely evolve independently versioned declarative Lifecycles without invoking or mutating project Suites, without self-modifying the Runtime core, and without weakening Harness or human authority.

evidence.authority: Roadmap application and Target drafting authority only.
Bounded Roadmap validation repair and Target drafting authority only.
Immutable published v6 completion baseline containing all 253 Runtime, Expert, inherited, E2E, and cross-acceptance criteria.
Read-only 100-percent DataRig Suite 2.1.11 capability inventory; not implementation or activation evidence.

include: Add typed observation and gap-classification contracts bound to exact project, LifecycleRevision, HarnessExecutionBinding, GoalTarget, Runtime, Host, Provider, environment, authority, and evidence digests.
Create immutable Lifecycle successor proposals with semantic diff, compatibility, impact, migration, experiment, activation, monitoring, rollback, and provenance records.

Execute comparable Champion/Challenger experiments only under identical governed task, Lifecycle, HarnessBundle, GoalTarget, Runtime, Host, Provider, environment, authority, evaluator, scorer, and evidence context; stratify non-comparable evidence.

Allow automatic activation only when an exact active policy preauthorizes a backward-compatible, reversible, non-destructive, non-public, no-new-authority class with verified rollback and canary evidence.
Monitor activated future-run pointers and perform deterministic policy-authorized rollback without mutating already bound runs or replaying uncertain mutations.

Represent project-specific production Pipeline semantics as independently versioned ProjectDefinition, Lifecycle, Policy, GovernancePack, ActionProvider, and related resources rather than Runtime source branches.

Use the exact active DataRig Suite 2.1.11 only as read-only production convergence evidence and produce datarig-production-delivery@1.0.0 with item-level provenance for all 20 inventory items and digest coverage for 90 critical plus 8 advisory files.
Escalate every missing generic primitive into an explicit Runtime or Expert Target proposal; refuse unsafe resource activation until that Target is separately approved and implemented.
Expose canonical MCP facts, previews, decision frames, receipts, audit, monitoring, and rollback operations for Evolution Expert 2.1.0 and qualified machine clients.

Preserve a real published immutable HarnessBundle-guided Goal Target Loop, external Harness authority, external Agent Runtime execution, tenant/workspace isolation, restart/resume, and v6 public compatibility.
Provide criterion-specific automated validators, 13 exact E2E journeys, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION over exact installed Runtime 6.1.0 and Expert 2.1.0 Candidates.
exclude: No DataRig, EvoPilot, evopilot-harness, forge, package-manager, database, or Agent-Host-specific Runtime branch.
No installed DataRig or EvoPilot Suite invocation, mutation, synchronization, Cutover, disablement, archive, uninstall, or retirement.
No Runtime self-modifying core, unreviewed code generation, hidden policy mutation, implicit activation, or conversationally inferred authority.
No Harness reasoning, authoring, review, approval, Catalog mutation, publication, or source change in EvoPilot.
No active-run rebinding, non-comparable evidence aggregation, uncertain mutation replay, raw credential storage, destructive or externally visible automatic action.
No production/database access, Host operation, Candidate build, E2E execution, publication, or Release under this draft.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime records typed observations and deterministic gap classifications with exact project, Lifecycle, HarnessBundle, GoalTarget, Runtime, Host, Provider, environment, authority, and evidence bindings.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schema, canonical digest, persistence, restart, drift rejection, and cross-surface contract tests.

acceptance.criterion: A classified project Pipeline gap produces an immutable Lifecycle successor proposal with complete provenance and never mutates the active revision or Runtime core.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Successor immutability, active-pointer stability, provenance, and zero-core-diff tests.

acceptance.criterion: Every successor exposes exact semantic, authority, dependency, compatibility, impact, migration, experiment, monitoring, and rollback diffs before validation or activation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Positive and negative semantic-diff fixtures with stable canonical output and completeness checks.

acceptance.criterion: Champion and Challenger execute under one comparable governed context and pairwise evaluation refuses or stratifies any context mismatch.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Pairwise experiment matrix, non-comparable negative corpus, evaluator/scorer bindings, and bad-case closure evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Policy-bounded automatic activation succeeds only for an exact preauthorized backward-compatible, reversible, non-destructive, non-public, no-new-authority class with verified rollback and canary evidence.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Decision-table tests covering every safe predicate plus fail-closed negative cases for each absent predicate.

acceptance.criterion: Semantic, policy, authority, production, database, credential, destructive, acceptance, publication, deployment, and Release changes stop at an exact Runtime-owned human decision frame.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Authority matrix and adversarial tests proving no inferred approval or readiness-to-authority promotion.

acceptance.criterion: Activation changes only future planning; every active Goal Target Loop retains and revalidates its immutable LifecycleRevision and HarnessExecutionBinding.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Concurrent activation and active-run start, iteration, retry, resume, and rollback boundary tests.

acceptance.criterion: Health monitoring evaluates declared signals and performs deterministic policy-authorized rollback with idempotent receipts and no uncertain mutation replay.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Canary, degradation, rollback, crash, receipt reconciliation, duplicate suppression, and retained-success tests.

acceptance.criterion: The exact DataRig Suite 2.1.11 snapshot is validated read-only and every one of 20 inventory items has exact provenance and one explicit disposition with 90 critical and 8 advisory files digest-covered.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Suite Gate PASS, manifest and content digests, item-count recomputation, disposition completeness, and no-Suite-write evidence.

acceptance.criterion: DataRig production semantics resolve as datarig-production-delivery@1.0.0 declarative resources and typed providers without a DataRig-specific Runtime branch or installed Suite invocation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Resource graph, provider qualification, no-project-branch source scan, legacySuiteInvocationCount=0, and equivalent journey evidence.

acceptance.criterion: A missing project-neutral primitive creates an explicit digest-bound Target proposal and blocks unsafe activation instead of adding a hidden project branch.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Gap fixture, generated proposal, stop reason, no-core-mutation proof, and subsequent generic-primitive path test.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime exposes project Pipeline evolution, experiment, decision, activation, monitoring, rollback, provenance, and audit through canonical MCP contracts used by Evolution Expert.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: MCP schema, protocol, idempotency, authorization, error-model, and cross-Host semantic equality tests.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime remains a project-neutral control plane: project Pipeline resource versions evolve independently and do not require Runtime or Expert releases unless a public generic contract changes.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent resource SemVer update tests, source diff checks, compatibility negotiation, and zero project-specific branch evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Harness authority remains external and every controlled evolution experiment and resulting Goal Target Loop binds a real published immutable HarnessBundle without weakening its obligations.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Public HarnessBundle generation/consumption, monotonic composition, digest drift, and authority-boundary E2E evidence.

acceptance.criterion: All mutation, experiment, activation, monitoring, and rollback operations are tenant/workspace isolated, idempotent, concurrency-safe, crash-safe, immutably audited, and SecretRef-only.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Isolation, concurrency, restart, audit, redaction, replay, and adverse-state tests.

acceptance.criterion: The controlled evolution loop never self-activates a semantic or authority change, never aggregates non-comparable evidence, and never exceeds an explicit recovery or experiment budget.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Property tests, policy corpus, exhaustion cases, and exact stop/next-action evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime 6.1.0 acceptance closes only on exact installed Runtime 6.1.0 and Expert 2.1.0 Candidates with all current criteria, the immutable v6 253-item baseline, cross acceptance, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION passing.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent completion recomputation bound to exact Candidate bytes, target digests, cross map, and zero failed, pending, stale, generic, silent-exclusion, or unmapped items.

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Every one of the immutable published v6 completion contract's 253 criteria, including Runtime, Expert, inherited, E2E, cross-acceptance, impact, NO_REGRESSION, and zero legacy Suite invocation, remains applicable and must pass against the 6.1.0/2.1.0 Candidate pair.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh successor validation of the full v6 completion contract with criterion-level evidence and no exclusions.

regressionImpact.area: Controlled Lifecycle evolution can affect every public v6 project, Lifecycle, Harness-guided Loop, external Agent Runtime, authority, persistence, MCP, Host, evidence, security, and release guarantee.
regressionImpact.reason: The immutable completion-contract aggregate preserves item-level historical traceability while avoiding a second drifting copy of its 253 criteria.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Bind and verify the exact active DataRig Suite 2.1.11 as read-only production reference evidence.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Manifest, Suite Gate, content, file-count, repository-kernel, and no-mutation evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Recompute all 20 inventory dispositions and prove 100-percent coverage with no silent exclusion.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Item-level provenance and disposition report with percent=100 and unmapped=0.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Create and execute datarig-production-delivery@1.0.0 from declarative resources and providers without invoking the Suite or changing Runtime core.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Resource graph, execution receipt, repository diff, and legacySuiteInvocationCount=0.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Classify a deliberately missing generic primitive, generate an explicit Target proposal, and stop without project branch or unsafe activation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Gap classification, proposal digest, stop frame, and zero source mutation.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Convert exact project run evidence into an immutable Lifecycle successor proposal with semantic diff and provenance.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Observation, classification, successor, diff, provenance, and unchanged active revision evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run comparable Champion/Challenger replays and reject a mismatched context from mixed aggregation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Exact bindings, pairwise scores, stratified mismatch, bad-case closure, and recommendation.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Automatically activate only a fully preauthorized safe successor for future planning after canary and rollback verification.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Matched policy predicates, activation receipt, canary proof, verified rollback, and unchanged active run.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A semantic or authority change stops at one exact human decision frame and cannot infer approval from dialogue.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Cross-Host decision-frame equality, negative inferred-approval proof, and finite next action.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Detect declared post-activation degradation and perform deterministic policy-authorized rollback without duplicate or uncertain mutation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Health samples, threshold decision, rollback receipt, restart reconciliation, and retained audit.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Start controlled evolution in Codex, inspect in Claude Code, complete designated WorkBuddy steps, and resume through generic MCP from one Runtime truth.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Exact Candidate/Core bindings, Runtime object equality, designated-human WorkBuddy declaration, and cross-Host resume.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Use a real published HarnessBundle to guide proposal evaluation and a Goal Target Loop without changing Harness assets or weakening obligations.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Registry, Catalog, HarnessProfile, HarnessBundle, component, export, Loop, monotonic composition, and drift rejection chain.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Complete a new unknown-project Pipeline evolution journey with both legacy Suites absent from the isolated environment.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Fresh install inventory, onboarding, successor, experiment, decision, activation or stop, and legacySuiteInvocationCount=0.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Revalidate the immutable v6 253-item completion baseline plus all 6.1 current criteria and impact closure on exact installed Candidates.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Independent criterion-level aggregation with passed=total and failed=pending=stale=generic=unmapped=silentExclusion=0.

designDecisions.controlPlane: Project-neutral Runtime-owned Lifecycle evolution resources and immutable revisions
designDecisions.projectSemantics: Independently versioned declarative resources and typed providers
designDecisions.safeAutomation: Exact active policy and all safe predicates are required; otherwise fail closed
designDecisions.suiteBoundary: Read-only production reference evidence only; zero invocation, mutation, dependency, or core privilege
